password.title: Change the password
password.description: After the change, your other sessions stop.

logins.title: External sign-in services
logins.none: Your account has no external sign-in service.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: An API key lets a script or another application use the Reliquary API for you. Each key has a daily quota. Keep your keys secret.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key "{{name}}"? The applications that use it stop working.
apiKeys.createdOnce: The key "{{name}}" is ready. Copy it now: the application shows it one time only.

dataExport.title: Export your data
dataExport.description: Get all the data of your account in a ZIP archive. The archive contains your account, your decks in text and JSON files, your folders, your tags, your favorites and the authors that you follow. It stays available for 7 days.
dataExport.pending: The server prepares the archive. Come back in a few minutes.

status.failed: Failed. Ask for a new export.

deletion.title: Delete your account
deletion.description: Reliquary deletes your account and all your data 7 days after your request. You can cancel the request during these 7 days. Export your data first if you want to keep it.
deletion.confirm: Delete your account and all your data in 7 days?
deletion.scheduled: Reliquary deletes your account and all your data on {{date}}.

delegations.title: Delegations
delegations.description: A delegation lets a module of this instance act for you, with the permissions that you choose, until a date. Revoke a delegation when you do not want the module to act for you.
delegations.noServiceAccount: No module of this instance can receive a delegation.
delegations.revokeConfirm: Revoke the delegation to "{{name}}"? The module stops acting for you immediately.
delegations.created: The module "{{name}}" can now act for you until {{date}}.

scope.decks_read: Read your decks, folders and tags
scope.decks_write: Create, change and delete your decks, folders and tags
scope.profile_read: Read your account: email address, name and language
